releaseNotes: v1.3.5 -- Capability-detection corrections, cross-checked against Reolink's own officially-backed reolink_aio library: corrected a v1.3.1 mistake where the doorbell's status/ring LED (supportDoorbellLight) was mis-mapped to the Spotlight feature -- split into its own 'Status LED' feature. Added a new 'Night Vision' feature (a real prior gap). Added floodLight back as a defensive Spotlight fallback. Ability lookups now check both the 'permit' and 'ver' sub-fields instead of permit alone, closing off a risk class where they could diverge. Confirmed (not guessed) the battery percentage field name. Also includes v1.3.4 (fixed connectivity-failure log spam; both the 'went unreachable' warning and 'connection restored' message are now always visible regardless of Log Level) and v1.3.3 (retry-once on a known older-firmware bug reducing false 'asleep' reports).
author: jdthomas24
